verdict.rationale: Moneybird is an accounting product, so customizing a chart of accounts is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers ledger accounts, account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions. The items cover authentication, contacts, invoicing, payments, MCP, and webhooks, none of which bear on chart-of-accounts customization.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
